name: What permits are typically required for major safety upgrades in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What permits are typically required for major safety upgrades in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For major safety upgrades in Daly City, such as seismic retrofitting, significant electrical rewiring, major plumbing overhauls, or structural modifications, permits are almost always required by the city's building department. These permits ensure that the work complies with local building codes, safety standards, and zoning regulations. The specific permits needed will depend on the scope of the project. A qualified general contractor can assist with identifying and securing all necessary permits before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Major safety upgrades in Daly City, like seismic retrofitting or electrical rewiring, typically require permits from the city's building department.
